package.name: perception_3d_msgs
package.description: Convex-polytope obstacle interface of the 3D pipeline. autoware's Shape is 2.5D (one footprint + a height) and cannot carry a cross-section that varies with z, so the pipeline publishes each object's true 3D convex hull here, keyed to the autoware track id — the geometry a convex-set safety constraint consumes. HUMBLE-ONLY like the rest of the 3D stack.
